tmdb_reviews.author: Dean
tmdb_reviews.text: *Insidious: Out of the Further* isn't reinventing the wheel on its sixth go-around, but it delivers enough legitimate chills to earn its keep. Directed by Jacob Chase, the film shines brightest when it leans into surreal visual set pieces—including a nauseatingly tense dental-chair sequence and a claustrophobic, spatial-warping couch fort. ai.summary: Delivers enough chills with strong visual set pieces despite familiar formula.

titles.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

tmdb_reviews.text: This is what Rambo First Blood would have been if he could have left and if he did have friends. It's a movie about police overreach, the strange fascination that Americans have for their veterans and for the parallel justice systems that exist in the brothers of arms.
